subject: Renewal roadmap: proposing quantized discount + phased signer flow
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@neotech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal roadmap: proposing quantized discount + phased signer flow

Hi Alex — following our renewal check-in earlier this week, attached is a compact proposal to get Neotech to a renewed committed capacity while minimizing procurement friction. High-level: 

- Quantized discount tiers by committed RU band (we're calling this a "quantized discount" approach): 4% / 7% / 11% at 1.5x, 2.5x, 4x historical monthly run rates.
- Mid-contract uplift credit available as a voucher pool so you only pay for incremental capacity.
- Split-pay cadence option (2 x 6 months) to align with your budget cycles.
- Phased signer recommendation: allow product-specific SOW sign-off (Search + Ingest initially) so legal/procurement can approve incrementally and we can provision capacity sooner.

Attachments: quantized_discount_example.xlsx, proposed_SOW_v2.pdf

Two asks: 1) Can your procurement team live with split-pay and voucher model? 2) Are you open to phased signing by product line to shorten lead time? If yes I can route a counter-offer and a DocuSign for the first SOW.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if useful.

—Ethan
Ethan Park | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@neotech.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@neotech.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap: proposing quantized discount + phased signer flow

Ethan — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A few quick points from procurement and finance: 

- Quantized tiers look reasonable, but finance prefers an up-front commitment equivalent to at least one quarter to avoid mid-year reforecasting. Split-pay helps, but we may need a deposit equivalent to 1 month.
- Voucher pool is intriguing; need clarity on how unused credits roll (rollover vs expiry).
- Phased signer is attractive operationally, but legal will ask for cross-product indemnities and a consolidated master amendment to avoid multiple independent SOWs. Could Solutions/Legal provide a compact master amendment template?

Let's book a quick sync with procurement (cc'd) and your finance lead to iron out the deposit and voucher expiry behavior. Prefer Wed 17th morning PT.

—Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Platform Procurement | Neotech Systems
alex.johnson@neotech.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ethan.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal roadmap: proposing quantized discount + phased signer flow

Ethan / Ben — reviewed Alex's feedback. Proposed internal counter (high level):

- Offer A (preferred): 8% blended quantized discount at 2x run rate with a 1-month refundable deposit, 6-month split-pay (2 installments). Voucher credits expire after 12 months but unused credits can be applied to next quarter invoice (no cash refund).
- Offer B (conservative): 5% flat discount + 1-month non-refundable deposit, vouchers expire at 6 months.

Risks & mitigation: the refundable deposit reduces churn risk and addresses finance's reforecast concern. Phased signer: legal wants a single amendment with product appendices; Solutions should produce a minimal master amendment template to speed review. See attached finance_impact_calc.csv for modeled P&L impact across the three committed bands.

Suggested next steps:
1) Confirm which offer Alex prefers (A vs B) on the Wed sync.
2) I will draft the consolidated amendment with product appendices (legal looped as needed).
3) Draft DocuSign for the first product SOW after procurement alignment.

If Ben and I sign off, we can present Offer A on Wednesday and use the DocuSign link for immediate execution for the first product.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Strategic Accounts Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: finance_impact_calc.csv

- Neotech prefers Offer A (8% blended quantized discount at 2x run-rate) with a 1-month refundable deposit and 6-month split-pay. Voucher credits expire at 12 months but will apply to the next quarter invoice if unused.
- Legal agreed to a single master amendment with product appendices; Laura will share the draft by EOD Thu.
- We will send DocuSign for the first product SOW (Search) this afternoon for a single authorized signer to speed provisioning. Production provisioning target: within 5 business days of SOW signature.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NEO-4821) | DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/NEO-4821-sign)
